lines.6: 「Left her behind. She wouldn't wake up.」
lines.7: 「Hehe... She's going to get mad again.」
lines.9: We exchanged some easy small talk.
lines.10: 「...I've always wondered. Isn't that thing you drape over your shoulders hot?」
lines.12: 「Is that why you keep your hair long too? It kind of looks like a shrimp...」
lines.14: That seemed to hurt her a little.
lines.16: Strange. Why did talking to Sato make me want to tease her just a little?
lines.17: 「Forward plus medium punch--Young Lady Bicycle Attack!」
lines.19: She hit me with her folded mountain bike.
lines.21: Blood was seeping from my temple where the bike had struck me.
lines.22: The Princess never held back with her punchlines.
lines.23: 「A badge of honor for a rambunctious boy.」
lines.24: She said it with a smile and walked off without so much as an apology.
lines.25: 「Ah, sorry... Ellie hit you too hard.」
lines.26: Sato took out a bandage she was carrying.
lines.28: 「Yeah. I'm kind of clumsy, so I get little injuries a lot...」
lines.30: 「Uu... Hearing you agree makes me feel complicated.」
lines.31: Even while complaining, Sato gently treated the cut.
lines.32: 「There. Good... It doesn't look like the injury itself is serious. I'm really sorry.」
lines.33: She softly stroked the wound through the bandage.
lines.34: 「You have it rough too, looking after the Princess.」
lines.37: Talking with Sato really did calm me down.
lines.38: Maybe she was what people called the soothing type.
lines.39: For some reason, most of the women around me were hot-blooded.
lines.41: The looks from people walking around us felt strangely painful.
lines.46: Konoe glared at me, then strode away.
